_doc: Documents the known, accepted differences between FidoCadJS's exporter output and the Java reference's. The Java-parity test fails if the actual TS output drifts from these patterns.

svg._doc: Lines below describe DIFFERENCES from Java that we accept. Update when an intentional change is made; otherwise the parity test fails.

differences.summary: Java emits trailing .0 on all numeric attributes; TS uses minimal representation (3 vs 3.0).
Java emits each header element on its own line; TS concatenates the header onto a single line.
TS emits stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round for line/rect/oval/polygon/bezier elements; Java only emits these for PCBLine.
TS uses font-size=sizex*2; Java uses font-size=sizey (smaller). See TOTEST.md S4.
TS places <text> at y=0; Java places it at y=sizey (so the baseline of the text is at the translate origin).
differences.tracking: TOTEST.md S3 — text element vs DecoratedText emission

differences.summary: TS computes yscale via a conditional involving sizey/sizex; Java always uses yscale=1 and bakes the aspect ratio into xscale (sizex/22.0/sizey*38.0).
Java always emits stroke-dashoffset (even when 0); TS emits it only when the phase has changed from -1 (initial state) — practically, it appears on the FIRST element only.

Java emits a typo `font-weigth=` (sic) on text elements; TS emits the correct font-weight: inside style=. CSS browsers fall back gracefully but Java's output is sub-pixel different in strict renderers.

matches: Translation to bounding-box origin with EXPORT_BORDER/2 margin
Mirror+rotation matrix on text (after Phase 1 fix S2)
Layer alpha on PCB elements via opacity= (after Phase 1 fix S6)
